title: feed.bet_stop
description: Betting stopped on these markets of a fixture: a provider bet stop, or kick-off (C05 §7, D5). Published by the feed service on NATS subject evt.feed.bet_stop (version 1). The markets are suspended in the catalogue and in Redis before the event is relayed. This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. Feed events are global: the envelope's tenant_id is null (B4a plan, decision 5). New fields are additive only.

fixture_id.description: Catalogue fixture ID (opaque; contract fixtures keep the contract's IDs, e.g. fx_arsenal_chelsea)

ts_ms.description: The provider's timestamp of the message, Unix milliseconds; changes apply in this order (FEED-07)
